question: Inside the four target-effective but linearly entangled heads, is selective temporal transfer carried by attention-pattern change, value-content change, or their bilinear interaction?
prior_art: The existing will/had fresh joint-reader pattern/value factorial supplies the exact P/V reconstruction method, but it tests different tasks, rows, reader sites, and a previously installed writer. No existing result factors the aligned v15 complete-head core or tests its P/C selectivity.
population: The same capability-qualified 16 A1, 16 A2, 16 aligned P, and 16 aligned C rows. Every pair is token-position aligned through the terminal semantic position.

sites.retained_complete_branch: All nine heads of attention 15 are installed completely in every factor-subset arm because its singleton has zero P/C flips and it is not part of the linear collision test.

exact_factorization.closure: The sum equals P_donor V_donor - P_base V_base at every selected head and token position through the semantic endpoint. No direction, rank, or scalar is fit.

factorial: Execute all eight subsets of the three factors jointly across the four heads, always with complete attention 15. The empty subset is attention-15-only; the full subset must reproduce the complete five-piece parent. A separate all-base response arm checks intervention identity.
selection: A factor subset is A1-eligible if A1 signed behavioral projection >=.75, direction fraction >=.875, P and C each have zero top-one flips, and max(P median KL, C median KL) <=.02. Select fewest factors, then largest A1 projection, then lexical factor order. A2 never selects and must independently reach the same target bars.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_reconstructio: All hashes/rows align; native attention reconstruction, factor closure, base-self error, and full-factor parent replay are <=1e-4; all metrics are finite; exactly 17 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_selective_attention_operation_sub: At least one of the eight factor subsets is A1-eligible.
predictions.pred_c_selected_operation_subset_confirm: The selected subset reaches A2 signed behavioral projection >=.75 and direction fraction >=.875 without A2 selection.
predictions.pred_d_selected_operation_subset_is_prop: The selected subset uses at most two of the three factors.
predictions.pred_e_factor_roles_are_nonexchangeable: Across A1 and A2, the selected subset exceeds at least one same-cardinality alternative by >=.10 signed projection or avoids at least two additional P/C flips.
predictions.pred_f_selected_operation_tracks_final_r: The selected subset has full-final-residual signed projection >=.50 on both A1 and A2.

terminal_policy.pattern_value_construction_failure: A and B pass but C fails.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: If a selective factor subset confirms, translate its P/V terms through QK and OV weights to explicit upstream writers/downstream readers, then test a fresh construction without reselection. If no factor subset is selective, use the measured finite factor-response matrix as the observation operator for regularized nonlinear DAS, retaining DIM/task-SVD and factor arms as fixed baselines.
